boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 129 is a Super Hard two-phase puzzle — the first half is a container-feed packing board, the second half transforms into a red cross sliding through stepped purple wall segments. Empty the top container while its counter drops from `4`, then navigate the red cross through increasingly narrow gaps. Force the cyan `2` tile early and it pins the cross against a wall mid-slide.
landmarks: Block Out Level 129 is a Super Hard two-phase puzzle — the first half is a container-feed packing board, the second half transforms into a red cross sliding through stepped purple wall segments.
Empty the top container while its counter drops from `4`, then navigate the red cross through increasingly narrow gaps.
Force the cyan `2` tile early and it pins the cross against a wall mid-slide.

quickTips: Every container counter must hit zero before the red cross phase begins.
The cyan `2` tile on the far right is a trap if moved before the red cluster clears.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the left purple `5` column and the blue `8` block without jamming the lower `5` container.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Feed matching bottom-grid colors into the lower orange-bordered `5` slot, then work the upper `21` container.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the red/yellow/green mid-grid clusters once the right-rail `3` counters thin.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the dense multicolor middle phase before the board opens to the cross puzzle.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Slide the red plus piece past the upper stepped purple wall, then past the lower purple ledge.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Drop the red cross onto the bottom red arrow indicator for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Starting the red cross phase while the top container still shows a number — the stepped walls stay locked.
Moving the cyan `2` tile before the red cluster on the right is cleared.
